contract: Typed model-advertised seed/steps/guidance/strength bounds and source/mask support extend existing image SDK without changing defaults. Requests pin selected model and canonical source/mask versions; bounded real decoding preserves alpha and source. Existing durable jobs invoke actual selected provider generate/edit under supervised worker and materialize canonical PNG with request lineage; mismatched selection, unsupported controls, unavailable provider and malformed output fail explicitly. No second queue or media byte store.
acceptance: Real typed provider/model/ImageResult contracts, genuine decoded source/mask/output pixels and unchanged source bytes, SDK compatibility, request validation and capability rejection, output idempotence/provenance, actual unavailable-adapter worker failure/retry, durable HTTP/tool requests and console control rendering. No fake provider endpoint; configured external inference and actual seed/control effect remain unqualified until an available real provider exists.
remaining_limits: No configured image inference provider or GPU was available; real generation/edit effect cannot be qualified locally
Existing OpenAI-compatible adapter advertises no advanced controls or mask; unsupported options are rejected, not ignored
Provider generation cancellation is cooperative at job boundaries; worker crash during remote inference may cause repeat inference on explicit retry
Full supervised installation, browser interaction and provider-specific control-effect qualification remain root/operator integration
